Bash(python3 -c "
import json, re

with open\('index.html', 'r'\) as f:
    html = f.read\(\)

# Extract JSON-LD block
match = re.search\(r'<script type=\\"application/ld\\+json\\">\\s*\(.*?\)\\s*</script>', html, re.DOTALL\)
if match:
    json_str = match.group\(1\)
    data = json.loads\(json_str\)
    print\('JSON is valid!'\)
    print\('Top-level type:', data.get\('@type'\)\)
    print\('dateCreated:', data.get\('dateCreated'\)\)
    print\('dateModified:', data.get\('dateModified'\)\)
    print\('mainEntity type:', data.get\('mainEntity', {}\).get\('@type'\)\)
    print\('mainEntity @id:', data.get\('mainEntity', {}\).get\('@id'\)\)
    print\('Person name:', data.get\('mainEntity', {}\).get\('name'\)\)
    print\('Person properties count:', len\(data.get\('mainEntity', {}\).keys\(\)\)\)
    # Verify all original properties are present
    expected = ['@type', '@id', 'name', 'givenName', 'familyName', 'jobTitle', 'worksFor', 'url', 'image', 'sameAs', 'alumniOf', 'hasCredential', 'knowsAbout', 'description', 'award', 'memberOf', 'speakableSpecification']
    for prop in expected:
        assert prop in data['mainEntity'], f'Missing property: {prop}'
    print\('All expected Person properties present!'\)
else:
    print\('No JSON-LD block found!'\)
")

import json

# Extract the JSON-LD from index.html
with open\('/workspaces/alexwalker/index.html', 'r'\) as f:
    content = f.read\(\)

# Find the first JSON-LD block
start = content.find\('<script type=\\"application/ld+json\\">'\) + len\('<script type=\\"application/ld+json\\">'\)
end = content.find\('</script>', start\)
json_text = content[start:end].strip\(\)

# Parse it
data = json.loads\(json_text\)
print\('JSON is valid.'\)
print\(\)
print\('=== TOP LEVEL KEYS ==='\)
for k, v in data.items\(\):
    if k != 'mainEntity':
        print\(f'  {k}: {repr\(v\)}'\)
print\(\)
print\('=== mainEntity keys ==='\)
person = data.get\('mainEntity', {}\)
for k in person:
    print\(f'  {k}'\)
print\(\)
print\(f'Number of Person keys: {len\(person\)}'\)
print\(\)
print\('=== Full mainEntity ==='\)
print\(json.dumps\(person, indent=2\)\)
")
